title: Lightning Cluster by Storm Hour
app: Raspberry Shake, Safecast, Blitzortung-compatible lightning sensors, AirGradient CO2 sensors, radon monitors, allsky cameras, and magnetometers streamed to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lightning:strike
| bin _time span=1h
| stats count as strikes, min(distance_km) as nearest_km by station _time
| where strikes>10 OR nearest_km<5
| sort - strikes
description: Uses Lightning detector feeds telemetry to monitor storm hours with dense strike activity or very near hits in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for fast-moving cells that matter to outdoor safety, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Lightning detector feeds data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights storm hours with dense strike activity or very near hits so you can spot fast-moving cells that matter to outdoor safety before it becomes annoying.
